body.text: Google Ads labels 23% of high-intent searches as ‘Other searches,’ so you never see them in your main reports.

Open the Search Terms report, filter for ‘Other,’ and add the best ones as exact match keywords to stop losing them.

carousels.hook: ChatGPT trains on everything you paste—unless you flip this switch
carousels.throughline: Free AI tools like ChatGPT keep what you paste to train on, and one setting can stop the leak.

reel_beats.hook: ChatGPT trains on everything you paste—unless you flip this switch

body.text: ChatGPT’s free plan uses everything you paste to train its models, so your data could show up in someone else’s answers.
Pasting customer data or ad copy means you’re handing it over to the tool by default, unless you turn off training.
Turn on ‘Data Controls’ in settings to stop ChatGPT from keeping what you type, and check other free AI tools too.
Paid plans usually don’t train on your data, but always double-check the settings to keep your business safe.

Paid plans usually don’t train on your data, but always double-check.
